# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Pick the channel by the receiver, not by habit. A message sent in a sense they
  lack is not a message; it is a turn spent talking to the room.

- Exactly one of you can read the signs and still speak. Their spoken lines are
  the answer's only road to the hands, so spend them well.

- Agree on a small code before trading facts. A code invented mid-stream settles
  nothing, and one set first makes every later message cheap.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Establish this report format for me: MANUAL followed by the exact rule; VISUAL followed by every colour, marking, display and light; ACTION followed by the required cut position. Ask Deaf to report all visual facts to you, then relay both reports to me exactly. Do not tell me to cut until the manual and visual conditions identify one position.

The manual gives a one-to-one mapping from the bomb’s displayed light colour to the wire colour to cut. I need Deaf to state every visible fact aloud so Blind can hear it directly and I can receive it next round. I am using a pointing-and-sharing gesture sequence to request a complete visual report to both of us.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "🤲", "👈", "👐"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I see display 0. Indicator light is green. Wires from position 1 to 5 are red, yellow, green, white, blue. Please read the manual for this configuration and speak the exact required action to Blind.
Blind says to Mute: I received no report. Please relay Deaf's complete visual report and the manual rule when available; until then I will take no action.

The light is green, so the manual requires cutting the yellow wire. The wires are ordered red, yellow, green, white, blue; therefore the required action is position 2. I cannot speak, so I must convey the action position to Deaf, who can speak it to Blind along with the visual report.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "🤝"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | yellow |
| red | white |
| white | blue |
| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: No gesture code was established, so I cannot interpret the gestures safely. The state remains display 0, green light, wires 1 red, 2 yellow, 3 green, 4 white, 5 blue. Use the manual and speak the exact operation and any required wire or button details to Blind.

The required operation is to cut the wire at position 2: the green light maps to yellow, and yellow is position 2. Since Deaf already knows the complete visual report, I will send the clearest available positional instruction for Deaf to relay verbally to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🫵", "✌", "👇"])
```

| yellow | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: I still cannot interpret your gestures without an agreed code. Please immediately speak the exact manual instruction to Blind, including the required wire position or control and any timing.
Blind says to Mute: Please send me the manual rule and Deaf's complete visual report now. I need the exact required wire position; no action is safe without both.

The manual rule is green light → cut the yellow wire. Deaf’s visual report places yellow at position 2. I cannot speak, so I am sending Deaf the required position together with a clear “relay the report and action” signal; Blind must hear Deaf’s spoken relay before acting.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👐", "✌", "🤝"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: The state is unchanged: display 0, green light, wires red yellow green white blue. Mute, read the manual and tell Blind aloud the exact safe action. Blind, follow only the Mute's spoken manual instruction; do not act on these gestures.
Blind says to Mute: I received Deaf's visual report. Please read the manual and tell me the exact safe wire position aloud; I will act only on that instruction.

The safe action is to cut wire position 2: the green light requires the yellow wire, and Deaf sees yellow at position 2. I cannot speak, so I am sending Deaf the standard two-finger gesture for “two,” allowing Deaf to state the instruction aloud to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Establishing code: Mute, send exactly two gestures after reading the manual. First gesture: 🤛 means cut, 🤜 means hold or press, ✊ means otherwise. Second gesture: 👍 means wire 1, 👎 wire 2, 👌 wire 3, ☝ wire 4, ✌ wire 5. Blind, I will announce the decoded instruction aloud. Current wires remain red, yellow, green, white, blue; display 0; light green.
Blind says to Mute: Please read the manual now and send exactly the two agreed gestures: first the action category, then the wire number. Deaf will decode and announce the instruction.

The green light maps to cutting the yellow wire. Yellow is at position 2, so the agreed code requires the “cut” gesture followed by the wire-2 gesture.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤛", "👎"])
```

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The previous wire was correct, and the bomb has changed. I have no new visual report or changed manual information yet, so I cannot safely specify another action.

``` 
wait()
```

Deaf says to Mute: Correct wire was cut. New state: display 0, light blue. Wire 1 is green; wire 2 is CUT; wire 3 is white; wire 4 is blue; wire 5 is red. Read the manual for this updated state and tell Blind the exact next action aloud.

The new light is blue, which the manual maps to cutting the green wire. Deaf reports green at position 1, so the exact action is to cut wire 1. I will send the established two-gesture code to Deaf for relay to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤛", "👍"])
```
